Details About the Event The Masters Tournament is one of the most exclusive and iconic events in world sport. Played each April at Augusta National Golf Club in Georgia, USA, it is the first of golf’s four major championships and is steeped in tradition. Since its inception in 1934, The Masters has captivated fans with its immaculate course presentation, legendary champions, and timeless moments — from Jack Nicklaus’ sixth green jacket to Tiger Woods’ emotional comeback in 2019. Attending The Masters is more than watching golf; it is an experience of history, pageantry, and prestige unlike any other. As with all Voyages.golf events, every detail is seamlessly managed so you can focus on enjoying the moment. The Format The Tournament Format The Masters is played over 72 holes of stroke play, beginning on Thursday and concluding on Sunday. The field is made up of around 90–100 players, including past champions, recent major winners, and the world’s best golfers. After 36 holes, a cut reduces the field to the top 50 players (and ties). The winner receives the famed Green Jacket and lifetime exemption into the tournament, along with a place in golfing history. Augusta National – Course Information Opening Date: 1933 Designers: Bobby Jones & Alister MacKenzie Par: 72 Length: Approximately 7,545 yards (6,900 m) from the championship tees Augusta National is renowned for its immaculate fairways, lightning-fast greens, and strategic design. Each hole tells a story, from the risk-reward par-5s to the treacherous Amen Corner (holes 11–13). The course changes subtly each year to maintain its challenge, but its iconic features — Rae’s Creek, Magnolia Lane, and the azaleas in bloom — remain timeless symbols of The Masters. First Name Last Name Email Join the waitlist now Travel Packages Frequently Asked Questions Where is the Masters played? The Masters is held annually at Augusta National Golf Club in Augusta, Georgia, USA. It is the only major championship played at the same venue every year, adding to its unique prestige. When is The Masters 2027? The tournament will take place from 05 – 11 April 2027 at Augusta National Golf Club. Tournament week runs from Monday to Sunday, including practice rounds, the Par 3 Contest on Wednesday, and the four tournament rounds from Thursday to Sunday. What is the weather like in Augusta in April? April in Augusta typically brings mild spring conditions, with average daytime highs around 20–25°C (68–77°F). Evenings can be cooler, so layers are recommended. Spring showers are possible, but overall conditions are excellent for golf and sightseeing. How can I attend The Masters? The Masters is one of the most exclusive sporting events in the world, and tickets (known as badges) are not available to the general public. The most reliable way to attend is through an authorised travel operator such as Voyages.golf, who provide packages that include event badges, accommodation, and transfers with golf rounds and even an escorted play-golf tour to the top iconic golf courses. Many travellers combine their Masters experience with golf at top regional courses, such as Old Barnwell, The Reserve Club at Woodside, Palmetto, and others in Georgia and South Carolina. Voyages.golf can arrange tee-times, transfers, and full playing itineraries around your tournament days. Where should I stay for The Masters? Accommodation for The Masters often includes Augusta hotels and private homes, as well as options in nearby cities such as Columbia (1 hour away) or Atlanta (2 hours away).
